derived_reciprocal_model.classification: minimal local lossless power-reciprocal completion of the source forward law
assumptions: uniform field vector during each modeled trajectory
no dissipative torque unless separately added

formula_ledger_ascii.reaction_doublet: F_K=(kappa_F L/2)[1/(beta_i r_i^2)-1/(beta_o r_o^2)](n cross g)
formula_ledger_ascii.lagrangian: Lagrangian=(1/2)M|v|^2+(1/2)A qdot^2-Gamma q(v dot b), qdot=L
formula_ledger_ascii.active_scalar_pair: M udot=G L; A Ldot=-G u
formula_ledger_ascii.motion_controlled_integral: Delta L=-(G/A) integral u dt=-(G/A) Delta x_b
formula_ledger_ascii.cell3_general: M vdot=K ell; A elldot=-K^T v
formula_ledger_ascii.cell3_eigenproblem: K^T M^-1 K phi=omega^2 A phi
